rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening annually.

example.traditional: 我哋每年都去一次旅行
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 heoi3 jat1 ci3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this to stress that something happens every single year without fail.

example.english: My mum makes turnip cake annually.
example.traditional: 我阿媽年年都整蘿蔔糕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 nin4 nin4 dou1 zing2 lo4 baak6 gou1

rows.note: Use this when specifying the frequency as exactly once per year.

example.english: This check-up only needs to be done annually.
example.traditional: 呢項檢查一年一次就夠喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 gim2 caa4 jat1 nin4 jat1 ci3 zau6 gau3 laa3
